family: Use proof.md's four-moment tagged affine-permutation outer evaluator with its fixed constants and zero guard branches. The NP verifier accepts exactly the empty witness when that evaluator outputs one.
theorem: For fixed K=8H and N0, this one family satisfies C_B2(f_n)>=4n-K*log2(n) at every integer actual length n>=N0 in native full B2. Its finite projection is (4,1).
